title: Wheat Rust Disease (Puccinia species)
content:
Wheat rust is caused by three Puccinia species: Stem Rust (P. graminis), Leaf Rust (P. triticina), and Stripe/Yellow Rust (P. striiformis). Rust can cause 30-100% yield loss if unchecked.

Symptoms: Stem rust — reddish-brown pustules on stems and leaves. Leaf rust — small orange-brown pustules on leaves only. Stripe rust — yellow stripes of pustules along leaf veins.

Favorable conditions: Stem rust (warm 25-30°C, high humidity). Leaf rust (15-22°C, dew). Stripe rust (cool 10-15°C, high elevation areas).

Management: Plant resistant varieties. Early sowing (before Nov 15 in North India). Avoid excess nitrogen. Foliar spray of propiconazole 25 EC at 0.1% at first sign of pustules. Always follow label instructions.
content_hi:
गेहूं का रतुआ तीन प्रकार का होता है: तना रतुआ, पत्ता रतुआ, और पीला/धारीदार रतुआ।

लक्षण: लाल-भूरे फफोले तनों और पत्तियों पर।

प्रबंधन: प्रतिरोधी किस्में लगाएं। जल्दी बुवाई करें। नाइट्रोजन की अधिकता से बचें।
summary: Wheat rust (stem, leaf, stripe) causes reddish-brown pustules. Plant resistant varieties, sow early, avoid excess nitrogen.
summary_hi: गेहूं का रतुआ लाल-भूरे फफोले पैदा करता है। प्रतिरोधी किस्में लगाएं, जल्दी बुवाई करें।
actions: Inspect wheat leaves and stems for reddish-brown pustules — rub a leaf on white paper; if orange powder rubs off, it is rust.
If rust is detected early, apply propiconazole 25 EC at 0.1% (1ml/L water) following label instructions exactly.
For the next season: sow wheat before November 15 in North India — late-sown wheat is much more vulnerable to rust.
Plant rust-resistant varieties: HD 3086, HD 2967, PBW 723, or DBW 187.
warnings: Do NOT confuse rust with nutrient deficiency spots. Rust pustules release orange powder when rubbed — nutrient spots do not.
Stripe rust can explode rapidly in cool, humid weather (Jan-Feb in North India). Scout fields weekly during this period.
